rules.rule: In Onyx's Next.js app, the `app/ee/admin/` directory is a filesystem convention for Enterprise Edition route overrides — it does NOT add an `/ee/` prefix to the URL. Both `app/admin/groups/page.tsx` and `app/ee/admin/groups/page.tsx` serve the same URL `/admin/groups`. Hardcoded `/admin/...` paths in router.push() calls are correct and do NOT break EE deployments. Do not flag hardcoded admin paths as bugs.

In Onyx, each API key creates a unique user row in the database with a unique `user_id` (UUID). There is a 1:1 mapping between API keys and their backing user records. Multiple API keys do NOT share the same `user_id`. Do not flag potential duplicate row IDs when using `user_id` from API key descriptors.

Never raise HTTPException directly in business code. Use `raise OnyxError(OnyxErrorCode.XXX, "message")` from `onyx.error_handling.exceptions`. A global FastAPI exception handler converts OnyxError into structured JSON responses with {"error_code": "...", "detail": "..."}. Error codes are defined in `onyx.error_handling.error_codes.OnyxErrorCode`. For upstream errors with dynamic HTTP status codes, use `status_code_override`: `raise OnyxError(OnyxErrorCode.BAD_GATEWAY, detail, status_code_override=upstream_status)`.

For changes under `documentation/`, check each added or removed sentence against "Decide what to include" in `.agents/skills/docs-writing/SKILL.md`. Flag a removal of content that the section's Diataxis type needs: on reference pages, inputs, outputs, auth, ordering and timing guarantees, limits, permissions, defaults, and error behavior; on how-to pages, prerequisites, required permissions or scopes, steps, and checks; on explanation pages, behavior the reader observes, such as freshness, deletion and pruning, permission sync, and limits. Flag a removal that is not one of: (a) a duplicate the reader still finds at the same point of need, (b) wrong per the code, (c) a code-level name (module, table, queue) the reader does not configure, (d) a UI restatement on an end-user page, (e) multi-tenant or test-only material. Flag a removal of every copy of duplicated content. Flag a changed product, edition, or plan name (Onyx Cloud, Enterprise Edition) unless the code shows the old name is wrong. Flag added text that does not serve the page's reader and task, that is more detailed than the rest of the page, or that sits away from the point of need, and a new section placed above more important sections. Flag a new image that shows a cropped control or uses a different framing from the other images on the page. Name the sentences to cut or restore.

Onyx keeps a feature map in `.agents/feature-map/`. When a PR changes behaviour, find the touched code paths in `.agents/feature-map/PATHS.md` and read the matching component documents in `.agents/feature-map/components/`. If the PR changes something a component document states (an endpoint, permission, env var, default, data model field, documented behaviour in section 4, or a contract in section 5) and does not update that document, flag it and name the stale section. Do not flag changes that leave every documented statement true. If the PR edits a component document, check the edited claims against the code in the PR.
